title: Pluggable KMS/HSM proxy + Secret-sync Terraform module for Private deployments
creator: Amina Patel
description: Deliver a reusable Terraform module that provisions a pluggable KMS/HSM integration layer and a secrets synchronization pipeline for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments. The module should support: (1) provisioning a KMS proxy service (for cloud KMS and on-prem HSMs), (2) optional HSM connector sidecar configuration, (3) a secrets-sync worker that mirrors Secrets Manager and Vault into the runtime keystore with idempotent migrations, (4) Prometheus-compatible healthcheck/metrics exporters, and (5) a zero-downtime rolling upgrade strategy for secret store upgrades and key rotations. This ticket covers design, IaC implementation, automated tests (unit + integration), and a runbook for rollout and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes inputs for: provider type (gcp/aws/onprem-hsm), hsm_endpoint, kms_key_arn, vault_addr, secret_manager_config, and rotation_policy
Module creates an HA KMS-proxy service behind a private LB and registers Prometheus metrics endpoints for upstream health and last-sync timestamp
Secrets-sync component performs incremental, idempotent syncs from Vault/Secrets Manager and stores a signed sync-manifest in state bucket to detect drift
Rolling upgrade plan documented and automated: canary deploy on 1 node, monitor key metrics, auto-rollout remainder on success, automatic rollback on regressions
Comprehensive terraform tests: unit plans (terratest/terraform-compliance) and an integration harness that runs in our CI private VPC that validates end-to-end encryption + rotation workflow
Runbook and alerting: clear SLOs, Prometheus alert rules, and runbook steps for key compromise, sync failure, and drift detection
Security review completed and module marked as approved for private-2025.04 release
tasks: Design module input/output schema and provider abstraction layer
Implement KMS-proxy terraform resources (LB, service, IAM roles, DNS entries)
Implement optional HSM sidecar and connector daemonset for on-prem customers
Build secrets-sync worker (stateless Helm chart) and migration hooks
Implement Prometheus metrics & health endpoints and example Grafana dashboard panels
Add CI pipeline jobs: plan validation, terratest integration in private VPC, and e2e rotation test
Create runbook, alerts, and security checklist; request security review
Prepare documentation and example private-deploy values for customers
